1→package sync
     2→
     3→import (
     4→	"context"
     5→	"fmt"
     6→	"sort"
     7→	"time"
     8→
     9→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/beacon-chain/db"
    10→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/beacon-chain/p2p"
    11→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/beacon-chain/p2p/types"
    12→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/cmd/beacon-chain/flags"
    13→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/config/params"
    14→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/consensus-types/primitives"
    15→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/encoding/bytesutil"
    16→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/monitoring/tracing"
    17→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/monitoring/tracing/trace"
    18→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/time/slots"
    19→	libp2pcore "github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p/core"
    20→	"github.com/pkg/errors"
    21→	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
    22→)
    23→
    24→// blobSidecarByRootRPCHandler handles the /eth2/beacon_chain/req/blob_sidecars_by_root/1/ RPC request.
    25→// spec: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/a7e45db9ac2b60a33e144444969ad3ac0aae3d4c/specs/deneb/p2p-interface.md#blobsidecarsbyroot-v1
    26→func (s *Service) blobSidecarByRootRPCHandler(ctx context.Context, msg interface{}, stream libp2pcore.Stream) error {
    27→	ctx, span := trace.StartSpan(ctx, "sync.blobSidecarByRootRPCHandler")
    28→	defer span.End()
    29→	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, ttfbTimeout)
    30→	defer cancel()
    31→	SetRPCStreamDeadlines(stream)
    32→	log := log.WithField("handler", p2p.BlobSidecarsByRootName[1:]) // slice the leading slash off the name var
    33→	ref, ok := msg.(*types.BlobSidecarsByRootReq)
    34→	if !ok {
    35→		return errors.New("message is not type BlobSidecarsByRootReq")
    36→	}
    37→
    38→	blobIdents := *ref
    39→	cs := s.cfg.clock.CurrentSlot()
    40→	remotePeer := stream.Conn().RemotePeer()
    41→	if err := validateBlobByRootRequest(blobIdents, cs); err != nil {
    42→		s.downscorePeer(remotePeer, "blobSidecarsByRootRpcHandlerValidationError")
    43→		s.writeErrorResponseToStream(responseCodeInvalidRequest, err.Error(), stream)
    44→		return err
    45→	}
    46→	// Sort the identifiers so that requests for the same blob root will be adjacent, minimizing db lookups.
    47→	sort.Sort(blobIdents)
    48→
    49→	batchSize := flags.Get().BlobBatchLimit
    50→	var ticker *time.Ticker
    51→	if len(blobIdents) > batchSize {
    52→		ticker = time.NewTicker(time.Second)
    53→	}
    54→
    55→	// Compute the oldest slot we'll allow a peer to request, based on the current slot.
    56→	minReqSlot, err := BlobRPCMinValidSlot(cs)
    57→	if err != nil {
    58→		return errors.Wrapf(err, "unexpected error computing min valid blob request slot, current_slot=%d", cs)
    59→	}
    60→
    61→	for i := range blobIdents {
    62→		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
    63→			closeStream(stream, log)
    64→			return err
    65→		}
    66→
    67→		// Throttle request processing to no more than batchSize/sec.
    68→		if i != 0 && i%batchSize == 0 && ticker != nil {
    69→			<-ticker.C
    70→		}
    71→		s.rateLimiter.add(stream, 1)
    72→		root, idx := bytesutil.ToBytes32(blobIdents[i].BlockRoot), blobIdents[i].Index
    73→		sc, err := s.cfg.blobStorage.Get(root, idx)
    74→		if err != nil {
    75→			if db.IsNotFound(err) {
    76→				log.WithError(err).WithFields(logrus.Fields{
    77→					"root":  fmt.Sprintf("%#x", root),
    78→					"index": idx,
    79→					"peer":  remotePeer.String(),
    80→				}).Debugf("Peer requested blob sidecar by root not found in db")
    81→				continue
    82→			}
    83→			log.WithError(err).Errorf("unexpected db error retrieving BlobSidecar, root=%x, index=%d", root, idx)
    84→			s.writeErrorResponseToStream(responseCodeServerError, types.ErrGeneric.Error(), stream)
    85→			return err
    86→		}
    87→
    88→		// If any root in the request content references a block earlier than minimum_request_epoch,
    89→		// peers MAY respond with error code 3: ResourceUnavailable or not include the blob in the response.
    90→		// note: we are deviating from the spec to allow requests for blobs that are before minimum_request_epoch,
    91→		// up to the beginning of the retention period.
    92→		if sc.Slot() < minReqSlot {
    93→			s.writeErrorResponseToStream(responseCodeResourceUnavailable, types.ErrBlobLTMinRequest.Error(), stream)
    94→			log.WithError(types.ErrBlobLTMinRequest).
    95→				Debugf("Requested blob for block %#x before minimum_request_epoch", blobIdents[i].BlockRoot)
    96→			return types.ErrBlobLTMinRequest
    97→		}
    98→
    99→		SetStreamWriteDeadline(stream, defaultWriteDuration)
   100→		if chunkErr := WriteBlobSidecarChunk(stream, s.cfg.clock, s.cfg.p2p.Encoding(), sc); chunkErr != nil {
   101→			log.WithError(chunkErr).Debug("Could not send a chunked response")
   102→			s.writeErrorResponseToStream(responseCodeServerError, types.ErrGeneric.Error(), stream)
   103→			tracing.AnnotateError(span, chunkErr)
   104→			return chunkErr
   105→		}
   106→	}
   107→	closeStream(stream, log)
   108→	return nil
   109→}
   110→
   111→func validateBlobByRootRequest(blobIdents types.BlobSidecarsByRootReq, slot primitives.Slot) error {
   112→	beaconConfig := params.BeaconConfig()
   113→	epoch := slots.ToEpoch(slot)
   114→	blobIdentCount := uint64(len(blobIdents))
   115→
   116→	if epoch >= beaconConfig.ElectraForkEpoch {
   117→		if blobIdentCount > beaconConfig.MaxRequestBlobSidecarsElectra {
   118→			return types.ErrMaxBlobReqExceeded
   119→		}
   120→
   121→		return nil
   122→	}
   123→
   124→	if blobIdentCount > beaconConfig.MaxRequestBlobSidecars {
   125→		return types.ErrMaxBlobReqExceeded
   126→	}
   127→
   128→	return nil
   129→}
